scientific_question: On an accessioned multi-guide direct-capture Perturb-seq guide-enrichment run, can DotMatch reproduce independent fixed-window per-read guide-barcode assignments while keeping ambiguous and unmatched reads explicit?

dataset.title: Combinatorial single-cell CRISPR screens by direct guide RNA capture and targeted sequencing
dataset.public_access: unrestricted public GEO/SRA records; the workflow retrieves source artifacts and does not redistribute raw reads

guide_library.sequence_column: Sequence of GBC (only used for GBC Perturb-seq)

fastq.selection: first 50000 complete FASTQ records from the gzip stream
fastq.retrieval_boundary: the bounded stream is stopped after the selected prefix; the reported full-archive MD5 is recorded but is not reverified unless the optional full-download mode is used

window_discovery.starts: all valid fixed-window starts shared by the discovery records
window_discovery.score: number of discovery records with exactly one exact target match
window_discovery.held_out_rule: discovery records select the orientation and start but are excluded from all reported agreement and QC metrics

comparators.name: exact_slice_hash
comparators.rule: classify the fixed window by exact target-sequence multiplicity

comparators.name: exhaustive_hamming_radius
comparators.rule: compute Hamming distance to every target and classify by the number of targets within radius one

analysis_plan.agreement_criterion: zero per-read differences in status, target identifier, and distance between DotMatch and the matched independent comparator on all held-out evaluation records
reported_qc: wall time and peak RSS for the complete bounded workflow

exclusions: the 2000 discovery records from correctness and QC estimates
speed or memory comparisons against unmatched tools or settings
known_failure_modes: the archive mirror or publisher workbook changes without its recorded checksum changing in the manifest
the stream is truncated or does not contain complete four-line FASTQ records
guide barcodes are not at one fixed position or orientation in the selected run
the discovery prefix contains fewer than five distinct exact guide targets or less than one percent exact assignments
the selected prefix is not representative of the complete run
duplicate or one-neighbour guide barcodes create expected ambiguity under the declared radius
non-ACGT windows are treated literally rather than as IUPAC wildcards
the paper supplement and deposited run encode different library revisions

resource_bounds.reason: the host had 11 GiB free before retrieval
